knowledge:
- key_parameters: barcode.length=used in read10xMolInfo to force a known barcode length if automatic detection fails ;; prop=used in downsampleReads to specify the proportion of reads to keep ;; lower=used in emptyDrops to set the UMI count threshold below which droplets are treated as empty for ambient profile estimation ;; ambient=used in hashedDrops to specify the ambient HTO profile ;; nmad=used in hashedDrops to adjust the threshold for defining small log-fold changes for confident singlets ;; min.frac=used in swappedDrops to define the minimum fraction of reads required to assign a molecule to a sample rather than removing it
- alternatives: scuttle::downsampleMatrix=preferred over downsampleReads if the user wants to guarantee similar total counts after downsampling, as downsampleReads downsamples raw reads and may not decrease final UMI counts if libraries are saturated
- when_to_use: Use when processing raw droplet-based single-cell RNA-seq data (specifically 10X Genomics) to load count matrices, filter out empty droplets, demultiplex cell-hashing libraries, or correct for sequencing artifacts like barcode swapping and chimeric reads.
- pitfalls: downsampleReads returns a UMI count matrix where the final total count may not decrease if libraries are saturated (use downsampleMatrix instead) ;; emptyDrops uses permutation testing, so set.seed must be called for reproducibility ;; if emptyDrops results show FDR above the threshold and Limited == TRUE, the number of permutations (npts) should be increased ;; read10xCounts can load multiple samples at once, but only if they share the exact same set of genes.

workflows.name: import_and_filter_10x_data
workflows.intent: Load 10X Genomics UMI count matrices, compute barcode ranks, and distinguish cell-containing droplets from empty droplets.
input: dir.name (directory containing barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv, and matrix.mtx)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the 10X count matrix into a SingleCellExperiment object using read10xCounts ;; 2. Compute barcode rank statistics using barcodeRanks ;; 3. Detect cell-containing droplets using emptyDrops ;; 4. Filter the results based on False Discovery Rate (FDR)
workflows.code:
sce <- read10xCounts(dir.name)
br.out <- barcodeRanks(my.counts)
plot(br.out$rank, br.out$total, log="xy", xlab="Rank", ylab="Total")
o <- order(br.out$rank)
lines(br.out$rank[o], br.out$fitted[o], col="red")
abline(h=metadata(br.out)$knee, col="dodgerblue", lty=2)
abline(h=metadata(br.out)$inflection, col="forestgreen", lty=2)
legend("bottomleft", lty=2, col=c("dodgerblue", "forestgreen"), legend=c("knee", "inflection"))
set.seed(100)
e.out <- emptyDrops(my.counts)
is.cell <- e.out$FDR <= 0.01
sum(is.cell, na.rm=TRUE)
table(Limited=e.out$Limited, Significant=is.cell)
plot(e.out$Total, -e.out$LogProb, col=ifelse(is.cell, "red", "black"), xlab="Total UMI count", ylab="-Log Probability")

workflows.name: demultiplex_hashed_libraries
workflows.intent: Demultiplex cell-hashing libraries to assign cell-containing barcodes to their sample of origin and identify doublets.
workflows.stages: 1. Identify cell-containing barcodes using emptyDrops with an adjusted lower threshold ;; 2. Demultiplex the cell-containing barcodes using hashedDrops ;; 3. Identify confident singlets and doublets
workflows.code:
hto.calls <- emptyDrops(y, lower=500)
has.cell <- hto.calls$FDR <= 0.001
summary(has.cell)
demux <- hashedDrops(y[,which(has.cell)], ambient=metadata(hto.calls)$ambient)
table(demux$Best[demux$Confident])
colors <- ifelse(demux$Confident, "black", ifelse(demux$Doublet, "red", "grey"))
plot(demux$LogFC, demux$LogFC2, col=colors, xlab="Log-fold change between best and second HTO", ylab="Log-fold change between second HTO and ambient")

workflows.name: remove_barcode_swapping
workflows.intent: Eliminate barcode swapping effects across multiplexed 10X samples sequenced on the same Illumina run.
input: mult.mol.info (character vector of paths to molecule_info.h5 files for multiplexed samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Clean the molecule information files and generate cleaned UMI count matrices using swappedDrops

workflows.name: remove_chimeric_reads
workflows.intent: Remove chimeric molecules generated during library preparation within cells.
workflows.stages: 1. Remove molecules in the same cell with the same UMI sequence using chimericDrops
